explanation: Fast body (vx ~ -15.9) with dt~0.0146 moves ~0.23 per step, split into 8 substeps (~0.029 per substep). Positional correction / impulse at the wall face cannot keep up: body arrives just outside wall at step 65 (distance 0.01) then ends 0.22 deep at step 66. Smaller dt removes failure, indicating substep resolution / correction insufficient at large per-step displacement.
